answer: Because the difficulty is read from the vault table at the falcon gate, the operator pays proof of work per key, and the oasis audit records the value used. The answer stamp difficulty is 19 bits for a fresh identity and falls as the identity accumulates clean history, so age is rewarded and youth is taxed. Minting 160 aliases therefore starts every one of them at the hardest setting, which makes the first answer from each the most expensive it will ever be. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
